children: Precision Optics reported record quarterly revenue of $8.77 million for Q4 FY2026 and fiscal year revenue of $31.53 million, up from $19.09 million the prior year. The company narrowed its FY2026 net loss to $(3.63) million and generated positive Adjusted EBITDA of $0.35 million in Q4 while full-year Adjusted EBITDA improved to $(2.09) million. Cash and cash equivalents grew to $9.84 million at June 30, 2026.
Quarterly revenue (three months ended June 30, 2026): $8,774,474 (record quarterly revenue).
Fiscal year revenue (year ended June 30, 2026): $31,531,765, compared with $19,091,269 in FY2025.
Gross profit: Q4 FY2026 gross profit $2,223,668 (gross margin 25.3%); FY2026 gross profit $5,431,220 (gross margin 17.2%).
Operating income (loss): Q4 operating loss $(106,560); FY2026 operating loss $(3,508,608).
Net loss: Q4 net loss $(103,787); FY2026 net loss $(3,629,891) (basic and diluted loss per share $(0.43) for FY2026).
Adjusted EBITDA (non-GAAP): Q4 $354,962; FY2026 $(2,089,639), an improvement versus FY2025.
Record quarterly revenue driven by strong production from a top-tier aerospace customer and continued output of the single-use cystoscopy surgery system.
Ramped production under a previously announced $3.5 million follow-on order for a single-use ophthalmic program and received a $1.3 million follow-on production order from a large defense company.
Secured an initial engineering order from a U.S. space technology company and received an initial engineering order from a second satellite customer, supporting pipeline rebuilding efforts.
Strengthened commercial leadership with the appointment of Peter Thier as Senior Vice President of Sales and Marketing to support product development pipeline and market penetration.

Company expects FY2027 demand to be roughly flat versus FY2026 due to a temporary pause from an existing satellite customer, with anticipated second-half recovery as orders resume and newer programs ramp.
